text: If you've got outdoor plans today, get them in early, because this one turns on you fast. Morning's pleasant enough, mostly clear and warm with a light south wind, but showers and thunderstorms build in by early afternoon and by tonight it's a washout, with a 90% chance of rain and a genuine flash flood risk as this system slows down overnight into Monday. The models are actually in rare agreement here about how wet it gets, even if they can't agree on today's high, anywhere from the upper 70s to mid 80s depending which one you trust. I'd plan for something in the low 80s before the rain takes over. The lake's rougher than average too, 2 to 4 foot waves building tonight with a south wind at 15 to 20 knots, so if you're on the water, be off well before the afternoon storms arrive. Monday doesn't offer much relief, with more showers and a continued flood watch for slow-moving storms. Best window today is late morning through about 1pm; after that, keep the rain jacket handy and don't linger on the water.
